themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents capable of performing complex tasks and making decisions autonomously within research contexts.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that help developers write, review, and debug code, often acting as collaborative partners.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights specific AI platforms and software designed to aid in various aspects of research, from data analysis to content creation.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's role in designing, distributing, and analyzing survey data for user insights.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Explores how AI can assist in analyzing qualitative data such as interviews, focus groups, and open-ended feedback.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text into concise summaries, extracting key insights.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Covers AI applications specifically in the realm of design research, including generative design and concept exploration.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Articles examining the impact of AI on job markets, recruitment processes, and the future of work.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial or simulated users for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers AI's application in analyzing and understanding user sentiment from reviews, feedback, and social media.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
